# 2025 Guinean presidential election

Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in Guinea in December 2025. They are the first to be held in the country since the 2021 Guinean coup d'état that installed general Mamady Doumbouya as president.
Background
The election date was announced by Prime Minister Bah Oury at the Africa CEO Forum in Abidjan, Ivory Coast on 12 May 2025. In June 2025, the ruling military junta established the Directorate General of Elections (DGE) to oversee the election.
